SELECTED_INDEX: 7
CONFIDENCE: 0.78
EXPLANATION: Strong aliphatic C–H stretches (3055, 2998, 2921, 2878 cm⁻¹) and CH2 scissoring at 1444 cm⁻¹ fit a long saturated chain. Two C–O–C stretches near 1125 and 1080 cm⁻¹ are characteristic of ether/epoxide. The cluster of ring modes at 919, 889, and 839 cm⁻¹ is typical for oxirane (epoxide) vibrations. Absence of an OH stretch supports an ether rather than alcohol. Candidate 7 (long-chain oxirane) best matches this pattern. References: GFQ-003 (C–H stretch) and general ether/epoxide C–O/C–O–C regions.
